subject: Institutional Master Plan Home Rule Petition
overview: The Council authorized an $8 million loan to replace lead water service lines and approved a Home Rule petition requiring master plans from large institutions like Tufts University. Members also honored the legacy of former School Committee member Bob Skerry and approved a new wage agreement for traffic supervisors.

items.title: Memorial Resolution for Ruth Youngblood
items.summary: Councilors honored the memory of West Medford artist and community fixture Ruth Youngblood, extending condolences to her family.

items.title: Memorial Resolutions for Robert Emmett Skerry Jr.
items.summary: The Council dedicated the meeting to former School Committee member Robert Emmett "Bob" Skerry Jr. and approved resolutions honoring his decades of public service.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the February 11, 2025, meeting.

items.title: Committee Reports on Zoning and Charter Recommendations
items.summary: Approved reports from the Planning and Permitting Committee regarding neighborhood residential zoning and the Governance Committee regarding Charter Study recommendations.

items.title: Zoning Amendment Referral for 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: Referred a petition for technical zoning amendments regarding dimensional standards, LEED certification, and building overhangs to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Kelly's Roast Beef
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Kelly's Roast Beef under new ownership.

items.title: MWRA Lead Service Line Replacement Loan
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an $8 million loan order to fund the full replacement of lead and unknown water service lines throughout the city. Engineering staff noted the program targets 2032 for full lead removal and will provide full replacements at no cost to property owners.

items.title: Traffic Supervisors Union Wage Adjustment
items.summary: Approved a multi-year wage adjustment agreement for the traffic supervisors union.

items.title: CPA Appropriation: Cross Street Cemetery Restoration
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 Community Preservation Act appropriation from the historic reserve for monument restoration at Cross Street Cemetery.

items.title: Home Rule Petition: Institutional Master Plans
items.summary: Approved a Home Rule petition seeking authority to require mandatory institutional master plans from large-scale facilities like hospitals and universities. Councilors and residents argued the measure is necessary to ensure institutions like Tufts University engage as equal partners in city planning.
